segments.sn22.10:1.4: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn22.10:1.6: paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
segments.sn22.10:1.7: Vedanā dukkhā … saññā dukkhā … saṅkhārā dukkhā … viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ atītānāgataṃ;
segments.sn22.10:1.12: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ viññāṇasmiṃ anapekkho hoti;
segments.sn22.10:1.14: paccuppannassa viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotī”ti.
